name: Effortless Backlinks
description: Done-for-you directory submissions: they match your product to up to 200 vetted directories (up to DR 98), write and submit each listing by hand, and send proof of every submission (company-stated). Pricing on the profile: Starter €79, Growth €119, Premium €179, all one-time (founder-stated). The homepage now also shows a Scale plan, 200 directories for €299 and a white-label offer for agencies (company-stated). ~160 estimated users (founder-stated). Founded Dec 2024, founder Janu Lingeswaran (7.6k X followers per profile).
